skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understand basic issues about economic contracts
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and identify fundamental issues related to economic contracts, design and implementation of contracts, warranty, changes, assignment, and termination of contracts.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understand types of economic contracts in investment projects
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand various types of economic contracts in investment projects and apply them to draft contracts.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understand basis for determining prices and price forms in contracts
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basis for determining prices and price forms in contracts, especially construction contracts, and apply them to draft hypothetical contracts.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understand process and content of contract management work
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the process and content of contract management work, from drafting, signing, and implementing contracts.
Understand and apply negotiation skills for contracts.
Understand and manage the contract execution process, particularly construction contracts, including quality, quantity, schedule, cost, and labor safety management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Manage relationships and prevent disputes during contract execution
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply methods to manage relationships and prevent disputes that may arise during contract execution.
Understand and apply evaluation methods for contract performance levels and contract management work.

Have the ability to self-study, complete assignments independently, work in groups, have a cooperative spirit, be responsible for work, have professional ethics, social responsibility, and legal compliance.
